scope.proved: The exact admitted unpublished package builds and passes installed-package smoke checks in the pinned official Node image on a native Debian Linux ARM64 Docker engine.
not_proved: final Hub Node or real-browser journey
Node, npm, browser or operating-system support floors

npm publication, release or production operation

implementation.change: The runner forces DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 for Docker subprocesses so the required BUILDPLATFORM and TARGETPLATFORM values cannot silently disappear through legacy-builder fallback.

environment.outer_node: v26.7.0 copied from the same pinned official image into the disposable staging root

gate_receipt.smoke: The Dockerfile rehashed the archive, installed with scripts disabled, required Node v26.7.0/npm 11.19.0, validated evidence-only package metadata and imported root, Node and browser public entry points.
gate_receipt.cleanup: The runner returned the receipt only after its task-owned tagged image and temporary context were absent.

observed_fail_closed_paths: The first staged copy was rejected before Docker because archive extraction retained group-writable modes; removing only group/world write bits from the disposable copy reproduced the accepted 0644/0755 source identity.
The unpatched runner reached the legacy builder and failed because BUILDPLATFORM and TARGETPLATFORM were absent.

DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 then failed closed while buildx was absent. Debian docker-buildx 0.13.1+ds1-3 was installed as the sole new package, after which the patched runner passed without an ambient DOCKER_BUILDKIT value.
The exact stopped legacy-builder container and dangling intermediate image were identified and removed separately; they are not represented as successful gate cleanup.

validation.typecheck: PASS after the required build under exact Node 26.7.0/npm 11.19.0

cleanup.retained: Pinned Node base image, Docker build cache and docker-buildx prerequisite remain in the shared guest for later native Linux gates; no broad cache prune was performed because pre-existing cache ownership was mixed.

independent_review.boundary: No predecessor lifecycle, final Hub/browser journey, platform floor, publication, complete F6 or F7 claim was accepted.
